title: Environment Management
description: Project-scoped maintenance of DB / syslog / web service objects; the default environment is used when not explicitly specified by cases, plans, or versions.
emptyDescription: Create an environment and add database / syslog / web service objects so executions can resolve connection info.
emptyObjects: No objects yet — add a database, syslog, or web service configuration
noSecretTooltip: Credentials not set yet (edit object → enter password/private key to save)
deleteConfirmReferenced: This environment is referenced by {{caseCount}} cases and {{planCount}} plans; these references are cleared automatically after deletion and executions fall back to the project default environment.
deleteConfirmUnreferenced: This environment is not currently referenced by any case or plan.
objDeleteConfirm: Delete “{{label}}”? Any configured access credentials will be cleared at the same time and can no longer be resolved during execution.

form.loginUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the plan check page, e.g. https://example.com/login
form.loginHelp: Configure the app login credentials for this web service. When a plan enables “login preparation” and no login case is selected, execution uses these credentials of the environment's default web service to fill the form automatically.
form.webNamePlaceholder: e.g. backend; leave blank for this environment's default web service
form.portPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the scheme's default port
form.webHelp: When a case fills in a relative path URL (e.g. /admin/login), it is joined with this service's origin to form the full address at execution time.
